Use authorized sharing controls only after checking the workspace, dataset,
metrics, mappings and filters. A shared dashboard can be opened by people who
have its link under the current sharing policy. Do not include sensitive segments
or assume a public link has the same boundary as an authenticated workspace page.

Choose Share link to open the email dialog. Add up to ten email addresses,
separated by commas or new lines, then choose Send email. Opening the dialog or
canceling it does not send anything. Sending saves the selected dashboard view
and emails a different read-only link to each recipient; their addresses are
not disclosed to other recipients. No email application needs to be installed
on your computer.

Choose Manage shared links beside Share link, or use the Shared links list inside
the email dialog. Find the recipient and creation date, select the trash icon,
then confirm Stop this link. Only that link stops working; other recipients'
links and other sends to the same address remain active. The dashboard and its
data are not deleted. Sending again creates new links and never restores a
stopped link. The Dashboards page's Shared links button lists workspace dashboard
links with the same individual controls. Copies already viewed or downloaded
cannot be recalled.

Older emails may have used one shared token. These appear as Legacy shared link.
Their individual copies cannot be separated retroactively: stopping that legacy
link stops all copies of that one token, but does not stop newly created links.

window, grouping, mapping and dimension filter before attributing the difference
to the source. Refresh or republish only through the application's supported
controls.

# Safe troubleshooting and support requests

Start with the active workspace, actual source coverage and the last confirmed
operation. A generic unavailable message is not proof of data loss, an expired
subscription, an AI failure or a connector permissions problem.

title: Safe troubleshooting and support requests

content:
Open Help & Support and use Ask Decisionate for product guidance. You can ask a
follow-up question, expand a cited documentation section, or open its product
page. AI answers and documentation excerpts are labeled separately. If AI is not
configured or cannot answer, relevant documentation remains available. Missing
evidence is not permission to invent an answer.

Factual guidance is taken from approved documentation sections, not invented by
the model. If the documentation does not establish the answer, the assistant
says it cannot confirm it from the approved information available at this time.
If only part is documented, it shares that part with an explicit limitation.
Related documentation is not proof that an unlisted feature exists, is
unavailable, or is planned. An unrelated question may receive a polite redirect;
an unclear question may need clarification. A source review date is not proof
of your account's live state. Human support can investigate missing details.

Questions and recent user messages may be sent to the configured AI provider
with approved customer documentation. Do not include private business records or
credentials. The assistant does not query live datasets, inspect your account,
read internal runbooks, access GitHub or execute actions. Guidance does not use
your business-analysis AI credits. Usage limits can require you to wait.

The conversation stays in the current page rather than a saved chat history.
Clear conversation, leave the page or switch workspaces to start fresh. Clearing
the page does not erase information already processed by the provider. Stop
waiting cancels the browser request, not necessarily a provider call in progress.

Contact support opens the normal support form with the latest question for you
to review. It does not send an email automatically or attach the entire chat.

content:
- No datasets: verify account/workspace and import status. A failed list request
  is different from a successful empty list. Retry the provided read control.
- No report-ready metrics: inspect the dataset, approved saved selection, date
  column and currency/policy warnings before selecting arbitrary fields.
- Insufficient relationship evidence: inspect real overlap, grouping, filters,
  variance and the observation count remaining after lagging.
- Anomaly not assessed: distinguish limited preceding history from no anomalies.
- Forecast unavailable: keep the selection and read seasonal/date/filter support
  warnings. A healthy Reports worker does not establish forecast availability.
- Save unconfirmed: preserve the draft and use recovery/verification controls.
  Do not repeatedly submit mutations or assume a failed response proves a failed
  save.
- Analysis queued or temporarily unavailable: preserve the selection, inspect
  progress and retry after recovery. Avoid creating many identical jobs.
- Email missing: confirm recipients and delivery history before resending. A
  completed scheduler request does not prove recipient delivery.

Do not include passwords, tokens, API keys, card details or unrestricted source
payloads. Raw stack traces and provider logs belong in an authorized diagnostic
channel, not a customer-facing chatbot.

already inspected the account, fixed the issue or changed a setting.

authorization. Report AI interpretation uses bounded selected evidence, not a

and support requests. An AI payload shape alone does not establish a provider's
training, retention, residency or contractual behavior.

relevant customer documentation to the configured AI provider when available.
It does not load your workspace datasets or retain a server-side conversation
history. Known credential patterns are blocked and email addresses are removed
from provider-bound question text, but this is not comprehensive personal-data
redaction. Do not submit sensitive records. Provider processing and retention

### Delete a workspace you own

The primary owner of a Professional or Agency workspace can open Settings and
use Delete workspace at the bottom. Choose Delete workspace, read the warning,
type the workspace name and choose Permanently delete. Opening or cancelling the
confirmation does not delete anything. Other workspace members cannot use this
action.

Any active workspace subscription must finish cancellation in Billing first;
scheduling cancellation for a future date is not enough. Agency owners must
remove or unlink their client workspaces before deleting their agency workspace.
Accepted clients retain their own workspaces and data. A paused client owner
first unlinks from the agency, then uses the Delete workspace option.
Running imports, analysis or AI requests must finish before deletion can proceed.

Deletion permanently removes the selected workspace's datasets, connections,
reports, decisions, access and shared links. Other workspaces are not deleted.
After success you are signed out. Your external sign-in provider account is not
deleted by this action. Provider data and copies already emailed or downloaded
are not recalled, and backups follow their separate retention cycles.

Use authorized support for an export, deletion or privacy request that is not
covered by self-service controls. Do not send credentials or unnecessary customer

# Joining periods and matching entities

Dashboard joins, entity matching and relationship tests serve different purposes.
A join combines evidence on a key such as a normalized period. Entity matching
groups records describing the same customer or product. Correlation studies
whether metric values vary together; neither other operation proves causation.

Open Compare data on a dataset dashboard with at least two available sources.
Choose datasets, source metrics and date columns, and apply each source's own
dimension filter if needed. Join selected data normalizes dates into comparable
periods. Check overlap, coverage, joined metric choices and mappings before
interpreting the chart. Reset joined data releases the joined analysis context;
review the restored selection before continuing.

No overlapping normalized dates, invalid date values or overly narrow filters
can prevent a useful joined comparison. A join does not create missing business
activity or make different currencies equivalent. Use Reports for a broader
multi-metric review and a frozen analysis snapshot.

Joined datasets are excluded from both Compare metrics report tabs in
Business Analysis and from Weekly Reports. Use original datasets for Multi-dataset
report and Single dataset report.
Existing saved report snapshots remain readable. An older report setup
with joined sources must remove them before running again.

content:
Entity Matching selects source datasets, customer or product type, matching-key
columns and analytical measures. The current resolver uses exact normalized
identifiers, emails, phones, SKUs and names; it is not a general fuzzy or
AI-inferred identity service. Choose the record date column for each source,
preview the matches, then save linked history. Each original row is retained,
including unmatched rows. Original source datasets are not modified.

Preview matches shows any missing identity or metric selections before a run.
If dataset columns cannot be loaded, Retry dataset columns keeps the chosen
sources and valid column selections. After saving, Linked history saved prevents
another identical save. Changing match approvals or the optional summary allows
an updated save; changing source or column selections requires another preview.

Linked history is a separate dataset with a shared record date, customer or
product identity, source dataset and source row. Original columns are kept with
source-specific names. Approved analytical measures keep their source's units,
currency and aggregation rules. Same-named amounts from different sources are
never automatically added together: a sale and an accounting invoice may be
the same transaction. Matching is not transaction deduplication.

The linked dataset is available for analysis when it has usable dates and
approved metrics. Select it as one dataset, including in Single dataset report;
it does not count as two datasets in Multi dataset report. Filter by identity or
source dimensions as needed. Missing
dates, unapproved metrics and gaps remain unavailable; matching does not create
missing data. Aggregated source history cannot be used as individual source
records. Entity Matching is optional for reports, forecasts and relationships.

Shared emails and SKUs are stronger exact keys. Matches that depend on names,
phone numbers, custom columns or reused local IDs need confirmation in the
preview. Unconfirmed links remain separate; independently supported links and
all source rows are retained. The preview displays up to 100 uncertain groups
and 20 records per group. Larger groups cannot be confirmed in this view; refine
the identity columns. Additional unreviewed groups remain separate.

Include entity summary by source optionally shows a summary for the first 100
identified entities after saving. It uses approved metric rules, not blanket
addition of every numeric field. It does not replace the dated history or
create a second analysis dataset. Unidentified rows remain in linked history,
but are not assigned to a customer or product summary.

Saving again with the same source datasets and entity type updates the linked
output. It is a saved snapshot, not a live connector; rerun matching to include
source updates. Other source combinations and older unified datasets are not
overwritten. Older unified datasets are labeled legacy summaries and cannot be
used as dated analytical history. Rebuild from original source records to create
the linked dataset; a first retained date on an old total is not transaction
history.

Exact normalized names are weaker evidence than a trustworthy shared identifier.
Two unrelated source systems can reuse a local customer or product ID. Confirm
that a selected key really denotes the same entity across sources rather than
assuming equal strings prove an identity. Do not submit personal identifiers to
a public chatbot for matching; use authorized workspace controls.
